claims.statement: Tom Allen and James C. Gallagher signed articles of agreement at Hennessy's saloon for a match.
claims.excerpt: betweem Tom Allen and James CC. Gallagher, to fight

claims.statement: Allen and Gallagher agreed to fight for $1,500 on November 1 within fifty miles of St. Louis, under the new London prize ring rules.
claims.excerpt: to fight for $1, 500, on the ist of Novembernext
places: within fifty miles of St. Louis

fights.place: within fifty miles of St. Louis
fights.excerpt: to fight for $1, 500, on the ist of Novembernext
fights.notes: Articles signed; this article gives no result. Gallagher's name printed as James CC. Gallagher.

notes: Articles signing only; the bout itself is described in later articles.
